acceptance: Evaluate the original metric against a comparable incumbent; disclose uncertainty and full cost.
conditions: Confirmed task; all learning is fit-only, including inner folds.
Published cases suggest conditional tests; their results are not measurements on this task.
constraints: changing training size or several components weakens attribution. CPU-only does not mean short runtime. A recipe successful elsewhere can fail here; a failed configuration does not rule out its entire model family. Inconclusive or unaffordable tests remain open questions.
contraindications: changing training size or several components weakens attribution. CPU-only does not mean short runtime. A recipe successful elsewhere can fail here; a failed configuration does not rule out its entire model family. Inconclusive or unaffordable tests remain open questions.
cost: Measure preparation, auxiliary fits, inference and refit.
diagnostic: measure the whole candidate path and dependencies. Ask which uncertainty a cheaper comparison would resolve. Preserve fit size, protocol and settings when attributing a gain to a component.
evidence_policy: Project synthesis of author reports; no complete human trace or local reproduction is claimed.
hypothesis: add or remove one feature block or ensemble member, compare a simpler representation, or compare forecast strategies on a representative temporal subset. Confirm promising findings under the intended learning scope and on fresh evaluation data when available.
minimum_experiment: add or remove one feature block or ensemble member, compare a simpler representation, or compare forecast strategies on a representative temporal subset. Confirm promising findings under the intended learning scope and on fresh evaluation data when available.
observations: one experiment consumes most of the remaining budget; an ensemble has unmeasured extra members; a plausible explanation of improvement has not been tested.
skill_text:
Cost and ablation

**Signal:** one experiment consumes most of the remaining budget; an ensemble has unmeasured extra members; a plausible explanation of improvement has not been tested.

**Check:** measure the whole candidate path and dependencies. Ask which uncertainty a cheaper comparison would resolve. Preserve fit size, protocol and settings when attributing a gain to a component.

**Candidate experiment:** add or remove one feature block or ensemble member, compare a simpler representation, or compare forecast strategies on a representative temporal subset. Confirm promising findings under the intended learning scope and on fresh evaluation data when available.

**Limits:** changing training size or several components weakens attribution. CPU-only does not mean short runtime. A recipe successful elsewhere can fail here; a failed configuration does not rule out its entire model family. Inconclusive or unaffordable tests remain open questions.

Sources: [Optiver author's ablations](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/optiver-realized-volatility-prediction/discussion/302626); [M5 author's implementation notes](https://github.com/Mcompetitions/M5-methods/blob/master/Code%20of%20Winning%20Methods/A1/0.%20README.md); [Rohlik author's report](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/rohlik-sales-forecasting-challenge-v2/writeups/golden-1st-place-solution); [Mercari authors' report](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/mercari-price-suggestion-challenge/writeups/pawe-and-konstantin-1st-place-solution).
